the types of inter-firm cooperation have a positive effect on firm performance.

cooperation with subcontracting, business associations and buyers can help to increase the firm performance of the garment industry in Lao PDR.

cooperation with business associations and distant suppliers is more effective in the garment industry cluster of Vientiane Capital.
the Lao garment industry cluster can be improved by strengthening the cooperation between firms and their business associations, which can help the firms to improve their performance.
inter-firm cooperation is an important tool for the Lao garment industry to develop its competitiveness in the global value chain and to improve its performance.
